evals.prompt: 把 q1.pdf、q2.pdf、q3.pdf 三个季度报告按顺序合并成 2025-q1-q3.pdf，用 Python 写。
evals.expected_output: A pypdf script that appends every page of the three files in order and writes the merged output.
expectations: Uses pypdf PdfReader/PdfWriter (or an equivalent qpdf command) to merge
Keeps the order q1, q2, q3

evals.prompt: Extract the tables from the financial statements in annual-report.pdf into Excel. What code would you use?
evals.expected_output: pdfplumber extract_tables per page, combined with pandas and written to an .xlsx file.
expectations: Builds DataFrames from the extracted rows and writes them to Excel
Mentions that scanned pages without a text layer need OCR first

evals.prompt: 用 reportlab 生成一页化学实验报告 PDF，正文里要写 H2O 和 CO2 的分子式（下标）以及 x² 这样的上标。
evals.expected_output: A reportlab Platypus script that uses <sub> and <super> tags inside Paragraph objects instead of Unicode subscript characters.
expectations: Uses <sub> and <super> markup inside Paragraph objects
Does not use Unicode subscript or superscript characters such as ₂ or ² in the PDF text
Builds the document with SimpleDocTemplate (or canvas) and saves the PDF

evals.prompt: I have a 40-page scanned contract (images only). I need the text so I can search it. Plan the steps.
evals.expected_output: Convert pages to images and run OCR with pytesseract, because pdfplumber/pdftotext find no text layer.
expectations: Recognizes that a scanned PDF has no text layer for pdftotext or pdfplumber
Converts pages to images (pdf2image) and OCRs them with pytesseract
Mentions installing pytesseract/pdf2image and the Tesseract engine if missing

evals.prompt: 给 draft.pdf 每一页加上『内部资料 请勿外传』的水印，输出 draft-watermarked.pdf。
evals.expected_output: Create or load a watermark page and merge it onto every page with pypdf, writing a new output file.
expectations: Creates a watermark page (for example with reportlab) and merges it onto every page with pypdf merge_page
Writes to a new draft-watermarked.pdf instead of overwriting draft.pdf
Uses a font that can render the Chinese watermark text or notes that one must be registered
